logic: Receipts that ReceiptDocumentFactory refuses to put together, with the refusal's message (ids written <id>); v2 never renders them. The cases have no input: the name says what was attempted, and the documents are built in ReceiptCorpusTest from the receipt fixtures

cases.name: a yearly receipt without a gift

expected.refused: A receipt certifies at least one donation

cases.name: a single receipt for a refunded gift

expected.refused: Only a received donation is certified, not REFUNDED <id>

cases.name: a yearly receipt with a gift from another year

expected.refused: A yearly receipt lists only donations received in 2026

cases.name: a receipt for another donor's gift

expected.refused: A receipt certifies only donations of donor <id>
